historical_research_vs_production: This file contains historical research only. Production simulated outcomes must be stored separately.

GDX_CALL_BUY_SHARE_SURGE_HIGH.win_rate_denominator: wins + losses among resolved historical candidate outcomes
GDX_CALL_BUY_SHARE_SURGE_HIGH.candidate_inclusion: Existing v1.0.0 base-signal instances reclassified using causal D0 GEX_Features only; no future-return target columns used.
GDX_CALL_BUY_SHARE_SURGE_HIGH.sample_size_limitations: Feature tiers were discovered by screening the available history; historical figures are not untouched out-of-sample estimates. v1.1.0-production freezes these exact feature predicates for forward use.
GDX_CALL_BUY_SHARE_SURGE_HIGH.entry_rule: Open of the 07:30 America/New_York 30-minute bar on D1, the first US trading session after ObservationDate.
GDX_CALL_BUY_SHARE_SURGE_HIGH.exit_rule: Close of the final regular-session 30-minute bar on D5; no TP/SL in v1.0.0.
GDX_CALL_BUY_SHARE_SURGE_HIGH.position_sizing: Normalized 1.0 notional per signal; no portfolio capital constraint.
GDX_CALL_BUY_SHARE_SURGE_HIGH.return_units: percentage points of normalized 1.0 notional directional return
GDX_CALL_BUY_SHARE_SURGE_HIGH.slippage: 0.0000% in historical research; results are gross/theoretical.
GDX_CALL_BUY_SHARE_SURGE_HIGH.transaction_costs: 0.0000% in historical research; results are gross/theoretical.
GDX_CALL_BUY_SHARE_SURGE_HIGH.overlapping_signals: Included independently. Multiple signal codes may coexist on the same observation date.
GDX_CALL_BUY_SHARE_SURGE_HIGH.repeated_same_day_signals: At most one instance per signal_code per ObservationDate.
